## v2.1.0

JellyPilot 2.1.0 adds UI languages, optional Linux embedded playback, Watch History, and a Paper-layout pass across Home, details, the player, and Personal Lists. Arch Linux users can install the prebuilt `jellypilot-bin` AUR package.

### Highlights
- Choose English, Simplified Chinese, or Follow system from Login and Settings. The change relocalizes screens, retained feedback, and tray controls without resetting login or playback.
- Select Embedded MPV Playback on Linux as an explicit Vulkan SDR option with an application-owned baseline; External MPV Playback remains the default.
- Open account-scoped Watch History for Jellyfin and Emby, with real totals, paging, timestamps, and landscape artwork.
- Favorite or Watchlist a movie or parent series from Home and the playback bar; the player Favorite still follows Now Playing independently.
- Remember per-season player volume locally per server and account, with a Playback setting that can pause saving without deleting records.
- Browse Paper-layout Home, Sidebar, Player Bar, details, Library, and Personal Lists: Title Logo heroes, a docked playback bar, full-window embedded controls, and synchronized grid/list shelves.
- Load Library Images from measured visibility, restore history-specific scroll positions, and keep Browse columns sized to the opened window.
- Connect to Jellyfin 12 without enabling legacy authorization, using the standard `Authorization` header and `ApiKey` for playback, subtitles, and remote sessions.
- Skip intro and credit ranges through Jellyfin's native media-segment API, including multiple ranges of the same type.
- Install on Arch Linux from the AUR as [`jellypilot-bin`](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/jellypilot-bin) (prebuilt) or [`jellypilot`](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/jellypilot) (source).

### Fixes
- Jellyfin 12 compatibility no longer depends on disabled legacy query authentication; modern `ApiKey` values are redacted in diagnostics.
- Returning to Home, browse results, details, and Personal Lists restores the matching vertical and horizontal scroll positions.
- Shared Library Image demand is isolated between pages and Now Playing, and native image handles outside the visible range are released.
- Browse poster placeholders keep a fixed image height, avoiding admission/cancellation loops while scrolling.
- Late browse deliveries are rejected across history restoration and model recreation; failed refreshes stay retryable.
- Confirmed Favorites changes appear in browse results immediately, and pre-write refresh deliveries are rejected.
- Embedded slider, volume, cursor, and menu interactions no longer commit stray seeks, toggle playback when dismissing a menu, or recover the cursor from the wrong reveal region.
